standing.title: Smorgasburg Prospect Park
standing.address: Breeze Hill, Prospect Park (enter at Lincoln Road), Brooklyn, NY
standing.description: Brooklyn's open-air food market at Breeze Hill in Prospect Park, with dozens of independent vendors. Free to enter; pay per stall.
standing.time_note: Sundays 11am-6pm; arrive before noon to beat the line.
standing.practical_note: Entirely outdoors; check the forecast and bring water in heat.
standing.date_idea_reason: Open-air food market you can graze through together, then walk into Prospect Park.
standing.why_now: Runs every Sunday of the season and pairs naturally with a Prospect Park afternoon.

standing.title: Whitney Museum Free Friday Evening
standing.description: Friday free-admission evening at the Whitney, useful for seeing the newly opened Roy Lichtenstein retrospective and current exhibitions.
standing.practical_note: Reserve free timed tickets ahead; walk-up availability can run out.

booking.reason: Free Friday timed tickets are limited.

standing.date_idea_reason: Free evening hours near the High Line make an easy art-and-walk date anchor.
standing.why_now: Standing Friday free-admission window falls on October 16.

standing.title: NYC Resistor Public Craft Night
standing.description: Open craft night at the NYC Resistor hacker collective: bring a project, use the space, meet members. Free and open to the public, 18 and over.
standing.time_note: Mondays and Thursdays 6:30-9:30pm. Free, but 18+ only.
standing.practical_note: Fourth-floor walkup; confirm on Eventbrite since craft night is occasionally cancelled for private classes.

booking.reason: Organizer asks visitors to confirm Eventbrite for cancellations.

standing.date_idea_reason: A free, hands-on makerspace evening is an unusual low-cost date with something to actually do.
standing.why_now: Runs twice a week year-round and is one of the few genuinely free weeknight drop-in activities.

standing.title: Queens Night Market
standing.address: Behind the New York Hall of Science, 47-01 111th St, Flushing Meadows Corona Park, Queens, NY 11368
standing.description: Open-air night market behind the New York Hall of Science with about a hundred independent food, art, and merchandise vendors, deliberately kept low-priced.
standing.time_note: Saturdays 4pm to midnight. Note the seasonal gap between late August and mid September.
standing.practical_note: Outdoors and cash-friendly; the adjacent lot charges for parking, so the 7 train is easier.

price.display: Free entry; most dishes capped at a few dollars

standing.date_idea_reason: Cheap, walkable, and genuinely varied: dozens of cuisines in one loop, good for a low-pressure evening.
standing.why_now: Runs every Saturday evening in season; the 7 train to 111th St drops you four blocks away.

standing.title: MoMA Free Friday Evening
standing.description: MoMA's Friday free-admission window gives access to the museum's modern and contemporary galleries without the usual general-admission price.
standing.time_note: Free Friday evening window, roughly 4-8pm; confirm ticket release on MoMA's visit page.
standing.practical_note: MoMA returned 403 to the fetcher; confirm the current ticket-release time before relying on this.

booking.reason: Free Friday evening tickets are limited.

standing.why_now: Standing Friday free-admission window falls on October 16.

standing.title: Whitney Museum free second Sunday
standing.description: The Whitney offers free admission to everyone on the second Sunday of every month.
standing.time_note: Admission is free to all on the second Sunday of each month during normal hours.
standing.why_now: Falls in this window and only comes around once a month.

holiday_plan.intro: For Oct. 10-12, favor rail-accessible Hudson Valley days first, and use Monday only after confirming each venue’s holiday hours, timed-entry rules, and return service. Do not treat normal drive times as reliable long-weekend estimates; if driving, re-check traffic before committing.

trips.title: Dia Beacon plus Beacon waterfront/Main Street
trips.why: A strong car-free art day: Dia Beacon anchors the trip, with walkable riverfront and Main Street time if the museum schedule works for the holiday Monday.
trips.transport: [Car-free] Metro-North Hudson Line to Beacon; Dia is near the station by local walk/taxi. [Car optional] Dia’s official driving directions list approximately 80 minutes from NYC in normal conditions.
trips.time_budget: Full day; allow extra buffer for holiday rail schedules and timed museum entry.
trips.booking_note: Dia’s official page was reachable, but the fetched content exposed directions rather than current public hours; verify Dia Beacon’s Oct. 10-12 hours, admission/timed-entry rules, and Metro-North schedules before going.

trips.title: Cold Spring and Hudson Highlands walking day
trips.destination: Cold Spring, NY / Hudson Highlands State Park Preserve
trips.why: A practical car-free nature option with village time plus official park trails ranging from easy to challenging; the state park page stresses marked trails, official maps, and sunrise-to-sunset use.
trips.transport: [Car-free] Metro-North Hudson Line to Cold Spring; use official NYS Parks maps for any hike. [Car optional] Parking exists at some trailheads but NYS Parks says parking is limited and illegal parking may be ticketed or towed.
trips.time_budget: Full day; keep the hike conservative because the park is open sunrise to sunset and return trains must be checked.
trips.booking_note: No park ticket is needed for basic hiking, but verify Metro-North schedules, trail conditions, and daylight; do not rely on third-party trail descriptions because NYS Parks warns some are inaccurate.

trips.title: Hudson overnight with Olana landscape and town time
trips.destination: Hudson, NY / Olana State Historic Site
trips.why: The best one-night choice on this list: Hudson gives restaurants, shops, and lodging, while nearby Olana offers Frederic Church’s designed landscape and Hudson River views. Olana’s official page says the 250-acre landscape is free and open every day from 8 AM to sunset.
trips.transport: [Car-free with local taxi/rideshare] Train to Hudson, then taxi/rideshare to Olana. [Car optional] Useful for linking Hudson, Olana, and nearby Catskill-area stops; keep traffic uncertainty in mind.
trips.time_budget: One night; go up Saturday or Sunday, use the next morning for Olana, and keep Monday return flexible.
trips.booking_note: Olana’s landscape hours were checked, but house/interior tours may require separate reservations; Amtrak’s official site was blocked during research, so confirm train schedules and availability directly before booking.

trips.title: Storm King Art Center sculpture-and-landscape day
trips.why: Large-scale outdoor sculpture and fall landscape in one place. Storm King’s official visit page says it is open 10 AM-6 PM Monday and Wednesday-Friday, closed Tuesdays, with final entry at 5 PM; in October it opens at 9 AM on Saturdays and Sundays.
trips.transport: [Car-required unless bus package is confirmed] Driving or rideshare is straightforward. Storm King says Coach USA offers roundtrip service from Port Authority including an admission option, but the Coach USA booking page was blocked/404 in this research; train options require a car/taxi from Beacon or Salisbury Mills-Cornwall.
trips.time_budget: Full day; arrive early enough for outdoor walking before final entry.
trips.booking_note: Buy/confirm admission in advance and re-check Monday Oct. 12 holiday hours; verify Coach USA directly if trying to make this car-free.

trips.title: Grounds For Sculpture and Hamilton/Princeton-area art day
trips.why: A closer New Jersey art-and-nature alternative if Hudson Valley options feel too busy or ticket-limited: Grounds For Sculpture describes 42 acres, more than 300 sculptures, rotating indoor gallery exhibitions, and arboretum grounds.
trips.transport: [Car-free by rail plus local taxi/rideshare] NJ Transit from New York Penn Station toward Hamilton, then local taxi/rideshare. [Car optional] Direct drive is usually within the requested radius in normal traffic, but verify holiday traffic.
trips.time_budget: Full day; build in local transfer time from Hamilton station.
trips.booking_note: The official GFS visit page was checked, but exact Oct. 10-12 hours/timed-entry availability were not exposed in fetched text; verify hours, admission, and any program registration before booking.

local_ideas.title: Governors Island on Indigenous Peoples’ Day
local_ideas.why: Official Governors Island pages state the island is open 7 AM-6 PM on Indigenous Peoples’ Day, with Governors Island ferries running on a weekend schedule from Manhattan and Brooklyn.

local_ideas.title: NYBG Fall-O-Ween
local_ideas.why: NYBG’s Fall-O-Ween page describes pumpkins, gourds, fall flowers, special weekends, carving events, beer sampling, and select-night light trail programming; verify the specific Oct. 10-12 ticket calendar before going.

local_ideas.title: Brooklyn Botanic Garden fall visit
local_ideas.why: A lower-travel city option for garden time; BBG’s official visit page is the right source for hours, tickets, amenities, and event calendar checks. The fetched calendar’s Fall Harvest Festival was Oct. 24, outside this holiday window, so treat this as a garden visit rather than that event.

local_ideas.title: Independence Hall / Old City Philadelphia as a stretch local-ish city escape
local_ideas.why: If you want a culture-heavy urban day or overnight instead of foliage, the official NPS Independence page was reachable and updated in 2026; use it to verify Independence Hall, Liberty Bell, and holiday operating details before committing. Amtrak was blocked in research, so transport remains unconfirmed here.

checks: Confirm each venue’s Oct. 10-12 holiday hours directly; several official pages expose general hours but not all holiday exceptions in fetched text.
Book timed-entry or admission where required, especially Dia Beacon, Storm King, Grounds For Sculpture, Olana house tours, and NYBG special exhibitions/events.
Check Metro-North, NJ Transit, ferry, and Amtrak schedules on the exact travel date; holiday/weekend service may differ from weekday patterns.
If using a car, re-check live traffic before departure and do not rely on normal drive estimates for long-weekend timing.
For hikes, use official NYS Parks maps, daylight limits, and trail advisories; Hudson Highlands is open sunrise to sunset and overnight camping/fire are prohibited.
For any bus-package option such as Coach USA to Storm King, verify directly because the booking page was not confirmed in this research.
